reasoning: The Alexandria cellar vault is left behind and lost, its worth folded into a new project in Bruges: a vast chiming clockwork Katelijne claims will track the tides for her ships, but which is secretly cut to mark centuries. Gains the named Skill Visionary.

operations.name: Visionary
operations.description: I can see the shape of a vast, patient mechanism years before the last gear is cut

operations.text: I break ground on a vast chiming clockwork in my Bruges warehouse, telling the guild it will track the tides for my ships; secretly each gear is cut to mark out centuries, not hours, and no mortal mind but mine can guess why.
